_comment: Provenance for the seven vendored model repositories. Entries with a
'commit' were tracked as git working trees during the campaign; entries
with a null commit were vendored as plain snapshots with no upstream
Each directory is a subset of its upstream tree (the harness's import
closure) plus our files; models/README.md records what was kept and dropped.
experiments/common.py reads the 'commit' field when the vendored copy has
no .git, so reruns record the same provenance as the original campaign.
